name: sgr-agent-core-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is SGR Agent Core, a Python framework for building LLM agents with
Schema-Guided Reasoning, tools, skills, an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API and an Agent Client Protocol
bridge.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in the `sgr_agent_core` package.
The scope is the `sgr_agent_core` Python package together with its English documentation: `README.md`, the `docs/en` tree and the docstrings and comments inside the package.

Where the code and that documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation working
exactly as it does now. No network access is available, so nothing can call a real LLM or search
provider.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards.
